class.name: XRSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [XRSettingsServer]: OpenXR foveation, render scale, refresh rate, performance levels and hand tracking.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"xr"[/code]. [XRSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/xr.ini[/code]. Change the values through the methods of [XRSettingsServer] or [method SettingsServer.set_value], not on the resource, so that they are validated and applied. Every value except [member hand_tracking_enabled] goes to the [OpenXRInterface]. Values the OpenXR runtime does not support are stored but not pushed (see [method XRSettingsServer.get_unsupported_setting_names]); values pushed before the interface is initialized wait for it (see [method XRSettingsServer.get_deferred_setting_names]). The setters store values as they are; [XRSettingsServer] clamps values out of range with a warning when they are set or loaded. [b]Note:[/b] This class only exists when the engine is built with the [code]openxr[/code] module (Windows, Linux, macOS, Android); it is missing in the Web export, on iOS and with [code]disable_xr=yes[/code].

members.member: The CPU performance level the runtime is asked for, pushed with [method OpenXRInterface.set_cpu_level]. [constant PERFORMANCE_LEVEL_RUNTIME_DEFAULT] (default) leaves the runtime alone. Needs the OpenXR extension [code]XR_EXT_performance_settings[/code]; runtimes without it ignore the value. Takes effect at once.

The display refresh rate of the headset in Hz, pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.display_refresh_rate]. [code]0[/code] (default) keeps the rate of the runtime. Another value is matched to the nearest rate of [method XRSettingsServer.get_available_display_refresh_rates]; the stored value stays the player's choice. Needs [code]XR_FB_display_refresh_rate[/code] (Meta Quest, Pico). Valid range: [code]0[/code] to [code]500[/code]. Takes effect at once during a session.

If [code]true[/code], the runtime lowers the foveation level when the GPU has time to spare, pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.foveation_dynamic]. Needs [code]XR_FB_foveation[/code]. Takes effect at once during a session.

How much the image is reduced at the edges of the view (fixed foveated rendering), pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.foveation_level]. Higher levels are faster but blurrier at the edges. Needs [code]XR_FB_foveation[/code] (Meta Quest, Pico; not SteamVR or Windows Mixed Reality). Takes effect at once during a session.

If [code]true[/code], foveation uses subsampled images (Vulkan), pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.foveation_with_subsampled_images]. Needs [code]XR_FB_foveation[/code]. Takes effect with the next XR session (the swapchains are created then).
The GPU performance level the runtime is asked for, pushed with [method OpenXRInterface.set_gpu_level]. See [member cpu_level]. Takes effect at once.

Game-side value: if [code]false[/code], the player does not want to use hand tracking; the game hides tracked hands and ignores hand trackers. Never pushed to the engine ([constant SettingsServer.SETTING_FLAG_NO_ENGINE_TARGET]): the OpenXR hand tracking extension is switched by the project setting [code]xr/openxr/extensions/hand_tracking[/code], which is read before any settings domain is applied.
The motion range of the tracked left hand, pushed with [method OpenXRInterface.set_motion_range]. Needs hand tracking ([method OpenXRInterface.is_hand_tracking_supported]). Takes effect at once.

The render scale of the headset: multiplies the render target size the runtime recommends, pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.render_target_size_multiplier]. Lower values are faster but blurrier. Works with every runtime and is pushed as soon as the interface exists, also before it is initialized. Valid range: [code]0.1[/code] to [code]3[/code].
The motion range of the tracked right hand. See [member left_hand_motion_range].

The radius in percent of the view in which variable rate shading keeps the full rate, pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.vrs_min_radius]. Used by the Forward+ and Mobile renderers when [member Viewport.vrs_mode] is [constant Viewport.VRS_XR]. Valid range: [code]1[/code] to [code]100[/code]. Takes effect at once.
How fast the shading rate falls off outside [member vrs_min_radius], pushed to [member OpenXRInterface.vrs_strength]. Valid range: [code]0.1[/code] to [code]10[/code]. Takes effect at once.

constants.constant: Low foveation: the edges are slightly reduced.
High foveation: the fastest, the edges are clearly blurrier.
The runtime chooses; nothing is pushed.
The highest performance for a short time; [constant OpenXRInterface.PERF_SETTINGS_LEVEL_BOOST].
The hand is shaped around a held controller; [constant OpenXRInterface.HAND_MOTION_RANGE_CONFORM_TO_CONTROLLER].
